Most often .jpg files with symbols and explanations of ice conditions. - Direct ice advisory to ships via HF radio Satellite data recorded in visual wavelength in resolutions of 15-20 m or better are very valuable for the inshore mapping program however fog, cloud cover and winter darkness is a significant limitation and imagery recorded with Synthetic Aperture Radar is a necessary complimentary datasource. Near real time delivery of data is critical for the inshore program however access to data within a couple of hours turned out to be acceptable. It is a minimum requirement that the tenderer has at least one reference to a similar supply undertaken, delivering satellite imagery for the use of sea ice detection or delivering satellite imagery with a proven capability to detect sea ice. The reference supply must have been provided within the last three years before the date of the application deadline. The date of provision is calculated as from the completion date. The offer will be evaluated on the basis of the technical evaluation price. The tender must state its prices in document C. The sub-criteria "quality" consists of: Order flexibility - 20% Satellite system - 20% Resolution - 20% Timeliness - 20% The terrain correction of imagery - 5% Complimentary Products - 5% Data policy - 10% See the tender conditions for further information.
